Open Add Wallet. The blue wallet type reads “SHA-256” and says it connects only when selected. Tap it and check that the format reads “SHA-256 · Native SegWit (BIP84)”. Tap XBT to see its format choices again.

In an XBT Lightning test wallet, switch between Transactions, Cross-chain payments and Funding. Each selected tab should expand, turn white and show its label in regular-weight text. Try the long Cross-chain payments label with larger system text.

On Transactions and Cross-chain payments, check the slimmer Receive and Pay (invoice) buttons. They sit slightly lower, with more space above them. Check that both lines of Receive are legible and that each control is easy to tap above the home indicator.
